notes: Added FEHA_WEAPON_ECONOMY.js using the completed 1-100 weapon power audit as the pricing source of truth.
Weapons still have no Mk. A hidden marketBand 1-5 now gates stronger and more expensive weapons behind higher-tier shops.
Price curve is power-based, while iconic/prototype/true-unique gear receives rarity premiums rather than arbitrary stat changes.
Errata, Chainsword Legendary, Dildo Stout, select prototypes/iconics, and all seven true unique weapons use reduced stock weights so they appear much less often.
True unique weapons are now allowed to appear rarely in arms, black-market, and corporate shops instead of being permanently excluded.
Market stock patch 1.4.0 now enforces weapon shop-tier gating, explicit allowed shops, and fractional rarity weights.
Normal weapons remain common within their eligible tier; higher cost corresponds to higher required vendor tier.
